title: Ya Imam E Reza
body:
Ya Imam e Reza(a.s) x 2
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Shabbir(as) k gham se meri Taqdeer Jagao
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao
Mai Hind se dekhun toh Khurasaa.n Nazar aaye x2
Yun meri Nigaaho se Hijabaat hatao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Moula Hai qasam aapko Masooma e Qum(sa) Ki x2
Har aashiq e Shabbir ko Roza pa bulao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Ya zaamin e Aahu tume Muslim ki Duhaayi x2
Maqroozo Ko Har Qarz se Aazaad karao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Ho Nemat e Aulaad Muhibbo.n ko Mayassar x2
Wallaha Inhi Deher K taano se bachao...
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Akbar(as) ka tasadduq tumhe Qasim(as) ki Duhaayi x2
Zahra(sa) k kaneezoan k suhaagoa.n ko Bachao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Hai Fatema Sughra(sa) ki yateemi ka Tasadduq x2
Ummat k yateemoan ko Musibat se Bachao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Sajjad(as) k jalte huwe bistar ki Qasam hai x2
Beemaro ko bistar se Shifayaab Uthao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Duniya e Purashuub me Dushwaar hai jeena x2
Shiyon ko har ek lamha Balaon se Bachao...
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
Kehte hain MUJEEB aur NABI ya shah e Mashhadd x2
Shabbir k ghamkhwaaron ki Imdad ku aao..
Ya Shah e Khurasaa.n Gham e Duniya se Chudao x2
